# 🚀 Automating Customer Support with n8n & AI {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

The "Oud & Scents" Eid Rush Scenario

## 🌙 The Context: "Oud & Scents" (Riyadh) {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="font-size: 0.9em;"}
- **The Business:** A popular local e-commerce store selling luxury perfumes and incense.
- **The Time:** 2 days before **Eid al-Fitr** (The busiest gifting season).
- **The Hero:** **Omar**, the only Customer Support Agent.
- **The Problem:** Omar logs in to find **800+ unread emails**.
  - Some are urgent crises.
  - Some are simple questions.
  - Some are spam.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## The Risk
If Omar answers emails in order (oldest to newest), he might miss a VIP crisis while replying to spam.
:::

## The Solution (The n8n Workflow) {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

We build an automated "Traffic Controller" using n8n.

::: {.incremental}
1.  **Step 1: The Trigger (Gmail/Outlook)**
    -   New email arrives at `support@oudandscents.sa`.
2.  **Step 2: The Brain (AI Agent)**
    -   n8n sends the email text to an AI model (like ChatGPT or Gemini).
    -   **Prompt:** "Classify urgency (High/Low) and Type (Complaint/Sales/Spam)."
3.  **Step 3: The Route (Switch Node)**
    -   **If High Urgency (Ahmed):** ➡️ Send **WhatsApp Alert** to Logistics Manager immediately.
    -   **If Sales Inquiry (Sarah):** ➡️ Send **Auto-Reply:** "Yes, we accept Tabby! Shop now."
    -   **If Spam:** ➡️ **Archive** immediately.
:::

## The Impact {background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

| Metric | Manual (Omar) | Automated (n8n) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Response Time** | Hours (Too late for Ahmed) | **Seconds** (Saved Ahmed's Eid) |
| **Focus** | Drowning in spam | Focused on solving problems |
| **Sales** | Missed opportunities | **Instant conversion** (Sarah buys immediately) |
| **Customer Mood** | Frustrated 😡 | Delighted & Loyal 😍 |

. . .

::: {style="margin-top: 1em;"}
> **Key Takeaway:** Automation isn't about replacing Omar; it's about giving him superpowers so he can focus on what matters.
:::
